name: lined-local-runtime-quality-scenario-catalog
description: Architecture-driver scenario catalog for Lined local kind runtime quality experiments. The catalog maps workload and deployment stimuli to ISO/IEC 25010 quality attributes, KPIs, SLO or constraint roles, and evidence sources. It is metadata for traceability, not a scoring formula.

evidence_kinds.description: Aggregated evidence collected from local kind runs, k6 summary output, Kubernetes state, Actuator health, or Prometheus-derived summaries.
evidence_kinds.collector_input: Allowed only when represented as the sanitized runtime-summary.json contract.

evidence_kinds.description: Sanitized metadata about how evidence was produced, including scenario path, workload, commit, timestamps, and command outcome.
evidence_kinds.collector_input: Not collector input. Use for audit, reproducibility, and exclusion reasoning.

evidence_kinds.description: Future non-live evidence produced by a model, simulator, digital twin, approximation, or manually constructed surrogate.
evidence_kinds.collector_input: Not interchangeable with live telemetry. Requires model version, assumptions, uncertainty note, and source provenance before use.

scenarios.stimulus: Stable baseline traffic is applied to the fixed-medium backend deployment after rollout and readiness.
scenarios.affected_artifact: Spring Boot backend Deployment and users/lobbies/tasks/events REST workflows
scenarios.expected_response: The backend remains ready, avoids request failure spikes, keeps p95 and p99 latency inside local experiment thresholds, and records comparable throughput.
scenarios.response_measure: latency_p95_ms <= 1000 ms, latency_p99_ms <= 2000 ms, error_rate <= 0.01, restart_count == 0, throughput_rps recorded
scenarios.evidence_source: k6 summary export, runtime-summary.json, readiness check, runtime-summary-manifest.json

scenarios.stimulus: The backend runs with the fixed-small resource envelope while stable workload traffic is applied.
scenarios.stimulus_source: k6 comparison-baseline or comparison-mixed fixture profile plus fixed-small kustomize overlay
scenarios.affected_artifact: Backend container resource envelope and workload-facing REST behavior
scenarios.expected_response: Resource pressure is visible without confusing warnings with hard validity failures; latency, errors, readiness, and restarts still determine stable comparison eligibility.
scenarios.response_measure: cpu_utilization > 0.85 or memory_utilization > 0.85 as warning; latency_p95_ms, latency_p99_ms, error_rate, readiness, and restart_count as hard constraints
scenarios.evidence_source: Kubernetes metrics, backend Deployment resources, k6 summary export, runtime-summary.json, runtime-summary-manifest.json

scenarios.stimulus: The backend runs as two fixed replicas while comparable workload traffic is applied.
scenarios.stimulus_source: k6 comparison-baseline, comparison-read-heavy, or comparison-mixed fixture profile plus replicas-2 kustomize overlay
scenarios.affected_artifact: Backend Deployment replica topology and workload-facing REST behavior
scenarios.expected_response: The two-replica deployment remains ready and stable while preserving latency and error constraints and recording throughput for comparison with fixed-medium.
scenarios.response_measure: throughput_rps, latency_p95_ms, latency_p99_ms, error_rate, restart_count, and readiness evidence
scenarios.evidence_source: k6 summary export, Kubernetes pod state, runtime-summary.json, runtime-summary-manifest.json

scenarios.stimulus: The backend runs under a CPU-based HorizontalPodAutoscaler while workload traffic creates scaling pressure.
scenarios.stimulus_source: k6 comparison-baseline, comparison-mixed, or comparison-stress fixture profile plus hpa-cpu kustomize overlay and Metrics Server evidence
scenarios.affected_artifact: Backend Deployment, HorizontalPodAutoscaler, and workload-facing REST behavior
scenarios.expected_response: HPA status records current and desired replicas when metrics are available; autoscaling context is interpreted with latency, error, CPU, readiness, and restart evidence.
scenarios.response_measure: hpa_current_replicas, hpa_desired_replicas, cpu_utilization, latency_p95_ms, latency_p99_ms, error_rate, restart_count, and readiness evidence
scenarios.evidence_source: Kubernetes HPA status, Kubernetes metrics, k6 summary export, runtime-summary.json, runtime-summary-manifest.json

scenarios.stimulus: Read-oriented traffic exercises bounded users, lobby, tasks, and events data.
scenarios.affected_artifact: Read paths for users, lobbies, tasks, and calendar events
scenarios.expected_response: Read-heavy workload remains within latency and error constraints while recording throughput for comparison across deployment scenarios.
scenarios.response_measure: latency_p95_ms, latency_p99_ms, error_rate, throughput_rps, restart_count, and readiness evidence

scenarios.stimulus: Write-oriented traffic creates bounded tasks and events with per-iteration cleanup.
scenarios.affected_artifact: Write paths for task and calendar event workflows plus database-backed backend behavior
scenarios.expected_response: The backend avoids request failure spikes and container restarts while recording latency and throughput under bounded writes.
scenarios.response_measure: error_rate <= 0.01, restart_count == 0, latency_p95_ms, latency_p99_ms, throughput_rps, and readiness evidence
scenarios.evidence_source: k6 summary export, Kubernetes pod state, runtime-summary.json, runtime-summary-manifest.json

scenarios.stimulus: Mixed traffic combines reads, updates, and bounded writes across the Lined backend workflows.
scenarios.affected_artifact: Combined users, lobbies, tasks, and calendar event REST workflows
scenarios.expected_response: The backend keeps mixed workflow behavior stable enough for deployment scenario comparison while recording objective and context signals.
scenarios.response_measure: latency_p95_ms, latency_p99_ms, error_rate, throughput_rps, restart_count, cpu_utilization, memory_utilization, and readiness evidence
scenarios.evidence_source: k6 summary export, Kubernetes metrics, runtime-summary.json, runtime-summary-manifest.json

scenarios.stimulus: Ramping virtual users create local stress pressure for exploratory capacity observation.
scenarios.affected_artifact: Backend deployment capacity envelope, HPA behavior when active, and workload-facing REST behavior
scenarios.expected_response: The run records pressure symptoms and provenance without being treated as stable comparison evidence by default.
scenarios.response_measure: latency_p95_ms, latency_p99_ms, error_rate, throughput_rps, cpu_utilization, memory_utilization, hpa_current_replicas, hpa_desired_replicas, restart_count, and manifest outcome
scenarios.evidence_source: k6 summary export, Kubernetes state, runtime-summary-manifest.json, optional runtime-summary.json when intentionally accepted
